title: Story premise ENT068: The Vanishing Stripe Train
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (perception and hidden objects). Hook: Nothing is moving. So why did that stripe shift? Takeaway/theme: Changing viewpoint can reveal depth hidden in one view.
description: A miniature detective wants to find which of three stationary striped boxes contains a toy train, but all look flat against striped scenery. They move a small viewing window sideways; parallax exposes the near box’s raised wheels, and the train rolls out only after being correctly identified.
